final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: Iref -> Rb -> diode MB ; V(ibias)=Vgs+Iref*Rb used as tail-cascode gate
Rb   ibias nb 28891.6
MB   nb nb vss vss nfet W=10 L=2.25279
* cascoded tail current source
MT   tc nb vss vss nfet W=1.94246 L=2.25279
MTC  tail ibias tc vss nfet W=3.94793 L=0.5
* NMOS input pair
M1   x  vinp tail vss nfet W=8.18247 L=2.72224
M2   y  vinn tail vss nfet W=8.18247 L=2.72224
* PMOS mirror load (diode on vinn side -> correct polarity)
M3   y  y vdd vdd pfet W=4.28357 L=1.5181
M4   x  y vdd vdd pfet W=4.28357 L=1.5181
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS current sink
M6   vout x vdd vdd pfet W=25.6368 L=1.81443
M7   vout nb vss vss nfet W=5.28011 L=2.25279
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz   x cz 46439.9
Cc   cz vout 2.51981e-12
.ends dut
